title: Emulated topology
description: Locations and links of the emulated network. It says nothing about which MultiChain node runs where: that is the experiment's node list, which references a location by id.

source.description: Provenance of the coordinates and of the link set (which historical file, which commit).

latency_model.description: Parameters of the physical delay model used to derive link delays from great-circle distance. Omitted when every link carries an explicit profile.

id.description: Location id, e.g. 'milan-it'. Referenced by experiment nodes through their 'location'.

label.description: Human label preserved from the historical .gml (e.g. HUB_IT_Milano).

kind.description: hub = backbone point of presence (1 Gbit by default); leaf = access site.

legacy_gml_id.description: Node id this location had in the historical .gml, so old and new artefacts can be cross-referenced.

profile.description: Name of a file in configs/network-profiles/. When absent the delay is derived from the latency model and the two endpoints' coordinates.

profile_overrides.description: Per-link overrides merged on top of the named profile. Same shape as a network profile, minus 'name'.

enabled.description: false keeps the link declared but never creates it: a permanent partition that stays visible in the topology.
